headline: Avianca and Grupo Plata Commit $3.34 Billion in Investments in Colombia
summary: Avianca and Grupo Plata announced an additional $3.34 billion in combined investment commitments in New York. The funds will support Avianca's airline fleet expansion and business growth.
why: Avianca is the flag carrier airline of Colombia and one of Latin America's primary aviation operators.

impacts.name: Avianca
impacts.why: New capital commitments enable Avianca to fund fleet growth and expand route capacity.
